Guides

Berlin hotel guides - districts and themes in depth

Our long-form guides: one per Berlin district, one per hotel category. Written for people deciding where to sleep, not for a ranking.

District guides

Where to stay, what it costs and how long it takes into the centre - one guide per Berlin district.

Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf

Hotels in Charlottenburg: elegance in western Berlin

Hotels in Charlottenburg: long-established 4- and 5-star properties on Kurfürstendamm, quiet boutique hotels around Savignyplatz and fair-value City West options.

Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg

Boutique hotels in Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg: alternative Berlin

Boutique and design hotels in Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg: individual properties by the East Side Gallery, the Spree and the RAW grounds - Berlin's most creative district to stay in.

Pankow

Family hotels in Pankow: child-friendly stays in northern Berlin

Family-friendly hotels in Pankow & Prenzlauer Berg: family rooms, quiet period-building streets and boutique charm near Mauerpark and Kollwitzplatz.

Mitte

Hotels in Berlin-Mitte: staying in the heart of history

Hotels in Berlin-Mitte: from luxury properties by the Brandenburg Gate and Gendarmenmarkt to affordable rooms at Alexanderplatz - you cannot stay more centrally in Berlin.

Spandau

Cheap hotels in Spandau: affordable stays with old-town charm

Cheap hotels in Spandau: affordable Berlin stays with a historic old town, citadel and Havel waterfront - well connected and ideal for budget and trade-show travelers.

Steglitz-Zehlendorf

Quiet hotels in Steglitz-Zehlendorf: green retreats by the water

Quiet hotels in Steglitz-Zehlendorf: peaceful retreats by the Wannsee, in the Grunewald and in Dahlem - Berlin's greenest district for restful stays.

Tempelhof-Schöneberg

Central hotels in Tempelhof-Schöneberg: urban Berlin with character

Hotels in Tempelhof-Schöneberg: central city hotels, boutique properties and budget options around Winterfeldtplatz, Tempelhofer Feld and close to KaDeWe.

Neukölln

Affordable hotels in Neukölln: staying in the creative quarter

Cheap hotels in Neukölln: budget-friendly and creative places to stay between Maybachufer, Tempelhofer Feld and Rixdorf - Berlin's most exciting district for young travelers.

Treptow-Köpenick

Lakeside hotels in Treptow-Köpenick: staying by the water

Lakeside hotels in Treptow-Köpenick: stay by the Müggelsee and the Spree with a spa, a beach and open water - Berlin's water district in the southeast.

Marzahn-Hellersdorf

Budget hotels in Marzahn-Hellersdorf: staying cheaply in the east

Cheap hotels in Marzahn-Hellersdorf: very affordable stays in eastern Berlin with solid S-Bahn and U-Bahn links and the Gardens of the World as the highlight.

Lichtenberg

Hotels in Lichtenberg: well connected and affordable in eastern Berlin

Hotels in Lichtenberg: fair-value business and mid-range properties in eastern Berlin with good connections, the Tierpark and the Stasi Museum - strong value for money.

Reinickendorf

Hotels in Reinickendorf: quiet in the green north, near the Tegeler See

Hotels in Reinickendorf: quiet family and mid-range properties in the green north of Berlin by the Tegeler See - 20 minutes to Mitte on the U6.

Steglitz-Zehlendorf

Potsdam & Sanssouci: day trip and stays at the gates of Berlin

Potsdam with Sanssouci Palace as a day trip from Berlin: park, palaces and how to get there - plus quiet hotels in Berlin's green southwest as a base.
